text: 48 1. Read aloud. Raghu goes to the market. 3.6 Raghu’s school was about to begin. He wants to buy books, pencils and colour box. So he goes to the market with his mother. On their way, he sees Aunt Neeta feeding grass to Kapila, her cow. He sees Deepa, Amey and Sara playing in the garden. Raghu waves to uncle Mane, standing outside the bank. There, he sees a dog and a cat sitting too. Finally, Raghu reaches the market. He stops to watch sparrows and pigeons pecking grains near the grocery shop. Then, he sees vegetable and fruit vendors. Raghu’s mother leads him to the stationery shop. There they buy books, pencils, a colour box and a story book. After buying things they come back home. Do you know? • Have you visited a market? • What did you see there?
